name: Thyroid cancer
theme: the good-prognosis trap · watching earned its trial

meta.title: Thyroid cancer in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Thyroid cancer (differentiated papillary/follicular/oncocytic, medullary, and anaplastic), adult
meta.population: Adults with thyroid cancer - THE GOOD-PROGNOSIS TRAP: incidence more than doubled (3.6 to 8.7 per 100,000, 1973-2002 - verified snippet; 49% of the increase was tumors under 1cm) while mortality stayed roughly flat and low over that period - the overdiagnosis story (Davies/Welch verified; the Korea 'epidemic of diagnosis' NEJM piece verified) - AND the honest nuance the sweep enforced: 'mortality flat' is verified only for 1973-2002, with later analyses reportedly showing a small rise in advanced-disease mortality (not snippet-verified - softened deliberately, no death count hard-coded). WATCHING EARNED ITS TRIAL: active surveillance of low-risk papillary microcarcinoma has verified decade-scale receipts (Kuma 30-year cohort, 3222 patients under surveillance: enlargement >=3 mm in 3.8%, NEW nodal metastasis in 0.8%, and no thyroid-carcinoma death in either the surveillance or the immediate-surgery arm; MSK kinetics verified) - de-escalation is this trainer's spine. THREE DISEASES share the gland: differentiated (the ATA-risk-routed, RAI-de-escalated one), medullary (the calcitonin clock and the RET revolution), anaplastic (the emergency where a BRAF test changes everything).
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the good-prognosis trap. THE DE-ESCALATION SPINE is the registry's most fully verified arc: overdiagnosis (Davies/Welch 2.4-fold incidence with flat 1973-2002 mortality, verified; Ahn's Korea NEJM piece verified) -> active surveillance with decade receipts (Kuma 8.0% enlargement / 3.8% nodal / zero deaths verified; the 30-year follow-up verified; MSK 483-patient kinetics verified; Korean multicenter corroborator verified) -> surgical de-escalation (the 61,775-patient NCDB receipt verified: extent of surgery not associated with survival in 1-4cm disease…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: ATA 2015 differentiated-thyroid-cancer guidelines (Haugen - PMID-verified, 101 recommendations; THE PUBLICATION-YEAR TRAP taught: the '2015' guideline was published Thyroid January 2016) with the low/intermediate-high recurrence-risk router; dynamic risk restratification anchored to the guideline itself (standalone receipts unverified this sweep - none fabricated); MTC and ATC run their own logic
meta.response: For DTC: recurrence risk and dynamic restratification (thyroglobulin surveillance at guideline grade); for RAI-refractory disease: SELECT's verified receipts (PFS 18.3 vs 3.6 months, HR 0.21, ORR 64.8%); for MTC: the calcitonin/CEA clock (doubling-time thresholds UNVERIFIED this sweep - carried as consensus concept without numbers); for ATC: the ROAR-generations discipline (updated 36-patient ORR 56% verified; the earlier 69% interim quoted only as the analysis it was)

Newly diagnosed.name: Active surveillance or lobectomy, RAI omitted (ATA low-risk DTC)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the ATA low-risk standard (guideline verified; each de-escalation rung receipted)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: the registry's most fully verified de-escalation arc
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: the least of any road - which is the point: same survival, smaller footprint
Newly diagnosed.patient: For small low-risk thyroid cancers: careful watching or removing half the thyroid - with survival identical to bigger surgery, no radioactive iodine, and often no hormone pill - the evidence for less is now the strongest evidence in this disease.
drugs: Active surveillance (institutional pathway) or thyroid lobectomy

Newly diagnosed.name: Total thyroidectomy + RAI + TSH suppression (ATA intermediate/high-risk DTC)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: lifelong hormone replacement; RAI's ledgers; suppression's cardiac/bone ledgers - the tier justifies them
Newly diagnosed.patient: For higher-risk differentiated cancers: the full sequence - complete thyroid removal, radioactive iodine, and hormone suppression - earned by the risk features, then relaxed as clean responses accumulate.
drugs: Total thyroidectomy + radioactive iodine + TSH suppression

Newly diagnosed.name: The RAI-refractory ladder (advanced DTC - when to start is the question)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the RAI-refractory standard (SELECT verified; the watching discipline guideline-grade)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: randomized receipts (SELECT numbers verified; DECISION qualitative; COSMIC-311 stale-flagged)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: the TKI ledger (hypertension, fatigue, proteinuria) - the reason when-to-start is a real question
Newly diagnosed.patient: When differentiated cancer stops taking up iodine and spreads: daily targeted pills that hold it for years - with one honest discipline first: slow, symptom-free disease can be watched, because the pills cost real side effects and starting is a decision.
drugs: Lenvatinib (sorafenib alternative; cabozantinib post-lenvatinib; driver doors where fused)

Newly diagnosed.name: Total thyroidectomy + nodal surgery (localized medullary)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the MTC surgical standard (consensus; ATA MTC guideline receipts unverified this sweep)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: convention-grade with the honest receipt gaps said
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: thyroid surgery's ledger + lifelong replacement (not suppression - another MTC difference)
Newly diagnosed.patient: For medullary cancer confined to the neck: complete surgery is the one curative treatment - radioactive iodine does not work on this type, and a genetic blood test comes first because this cancer sometimes runs in families.

Newly diagnosed.name: Selpercatinib first if RET-mutant (advanced medullary - the 531 turn)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the post-531 standard (verified trial + verified full approval)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: randomized phase 3 (verified) + full approval (verified); effect sizes not over-quoted
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: selpercatinib's ledger (hypertension, QT, edema) - lighter than the multikinase drugs it beat
Newly diagnosed.patient: For spread medullary cancer with a RET mutation - which most have: a precise daily pill that beat the older drugs head-to-head in 2023 and holds the disease longer with fewer side effects.
drugs: Selpercatinib (RET-mutant) / cabozantinib or vandetanib (RET-wild-type or later line)

Newly diagnosed.name: The anaplastic emergency (BRAF-tested multimodal - the conversion strategy)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the modern ATC pathway (verified receipts; DTP framing emerging-SOC, secondhand)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: verified single-arm and series receipts; medians flagged/secondhand as marked
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: the combination's ledger - accepted against the registry's fastest disease
Newly diagnosed.patient: Anaplastic thyroid cancer moves in weeks - so the first move is a same-week genetic test: if BRAF-positive, targeted pills can shrink an inoperable tumor until surgery becomes possible - in the index series, every single patient became operable.
drugs: Dabrafenib + trametinib (BRAF V600E; +/- pembrolizumab per the neoadjuvant series) or multimodal chemo-RT

Newly diagnosed.name: Comfort-focused care
Newly diagnosed.guideline: always on the menu, never by drift
Newly diagnosed.patient: Comfort-focused care is a real choice at every step - and for the slow types, even this road is often measured in years.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Restratify and salvage (recurrent DTC)
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: A differentiated-cancer return usually still has good roads: surgery for neck disease, iodine if the cancer still drinks it, and the targeted pills held in reserve for when they are truly needed.
drugs: Salvage surgery / RAI (if avid) / the ladder (if refractory)

Relapsed / recurrent.name: The next RET line (progressive medullary - and the pullback honesty)
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: exposure-routed lines (verified receipts); the frontier behind flags
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: verified trial receipts per line; figure flagged
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: line-dependent (the multikinase ledgers are heavier - part of why 531 mattered)
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: If medullary cancer progresses: the next matched pill - and an honest note that several next-generation drugs in this family were abandoned by their companies, with one survivor still in trials.
drugs: Selpercatinib (if naive) / cabozantinib / vandetanib; EP0031 door flagged

Relapsed / recurrent.name: The short road, honestly (progressive anaplastic)
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: When anaplastic cancer progresses despite treatment: honest conversations come first - studies where they truly exist, radiation for comfort, and care built around the days.
drugs: Trial routes (where eligible) + palliative radiotherapy + comfort care

refs.label: ATA 2015 differentiated-thyroid-cancer guidelines (Haugen - PMID 26462967, pubmed-url-match): 101 recommendations; THE PUBLICATION-YEAR TRAP taught (published Thyroid January 2016). The low vs intermediate/high recurrence-risk router, the lobectomy shift, risk-adapted RAI, tier-dosed TSH suppression, and DYNAMIC RESTRATIFICATION all anchor here (the standalone restratification receipts unverified this sweep - none fabricated; the what-changed companion 27741354 matched) | PMID 26462967 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE GOOD-PROGNOSIS TRAP, verified: Davies/Welch (JAMA 2006 - PMID 16684987, pubmed-url-match): incidence 3.6->8.7/100k 1973-2002 (2.4-fold; papillary 2.9-fold; 49% of increase <=1cm, 87% <=2cm; MORTALITY STABLE over that window - all verified snippet); Ahn/Welch Korea 'epidemic' (NEJM 2014 - PMID 25372084, matched); Lim 2017 trends (PMID 28362912, matched - title only; the reported small advanced-disease mortality rise NOT snippet-verified: the 'mortality flat' claim is SOFTENED to its verified window and no annual death count is hard-coded) | PMID 16684987 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

ACTIVE SURVEILLANCE, verified at decade scale: Kuma Hospital 30-year cohort, read firsthand 2026-09-10 (Thyroid 2023;33(10) PMID 37166389; 5646 low-risk papillary microcarcinomas 1993-2019, 3222 under active surveillance and 2424 to immediate surgery): tumour enlargement >=3 mm in 124 of 3222 (3.8%), with 10- and 20-year enlargement rates of 4.7% and 6.6%; NEW nodal metastasis in 27 (0.8%), 10- and 20-year rates 1.0% and 1.6%; NO patient in either group died of thyroid carcinoma; one distant metastatic recurrence occurred after surveillance and conversion surgery and one after immediate surgery, both patients alive at 18.4 and 18.8 years. THREE CORRECTIONS at that read: the figures previously shown ('enlargement >=3mm 8.0%, nodal metastasis 3.8%') had the enlargement and nodal rates transposed and inflated - 3.8% is the enlargement rate and the true nodal rate is 0.8%, so nodal risk had been overstated roughly fivefold; 'ZERO distant mets' is not accurate, as two distant recurrences are reported (both patients alive); and the citation PMID 32025528 given for the protocol is NOT a paper at all but VideoEndocrinology 2016;3(3), a video article, so it has been dropped as the outcomes source; Ito/Miyauchi review (28343733, matched); Korean multicenter KoMPASS corroborator (36205563, matched). US status: an INSTITUTIONAL pathway (MSK) - no US NCT verified (said; none cited from memory) | PMID 32025528 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

MSK active-surveillance kinetics (Tuttle, JAMA Otolaryngol 2017 - PMID 28859191, pubmed-url-match): 483 patients, tumors <=1.5cm; ~78.8% 5-year stability, 10.0% early growth (search-summary-adjacent figures, marked) | PMID 28859191 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE LOBECTOMY RECEIPT (Adam, Ann Surg 2014 - PMID 25203876, pubmed-url-match): 61,775 NCDB patients, 1.0-4.0cm tumors - extent of surgery NOT associated with overall survival (verified snippet) - the empirical basis of the 2015 ATA lobectomy shift | PMID 25203876 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

RAI DE-ESCALATION: ESTIMABL2 (Leboulleux, NEJM 2022 - PMID 35263518, pubmed-url-match: no-RAI noninferior in low-risk pT1a(m)/pT1b N0/Nx at 3 years) + 5-year follow-up (39586309, matched); IoN PRIMARY (Mallick, The Lancet, published 2025-07-05, NCT01398085) - PMID NEVER MATCHED: FLAGGED, journal-cited, non-inferiority result at search-summary grade (highest-priority re-verification); IoN protocol paper matched (22316618); HiLo long-term low-dose receipt (30501974, matched). THE CONFLATION TRAPS documented: ESTIMABL1 (29807824) = dose-EQUIVALENCE not omission; HiLo = dose-de-escalation - search summaries repeatedly blended the generations | PMID 35263518 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

SELECT (Schlumberger, NEJM 2015 - PMID 25671254, pubmed-url-match): lenvatinib in RAI-refractory DTC - PFS 18.3 vs 3.6 months, HR 0.21 (99% CI 0.14-0.31), ORR 64.8% vs 1.5% - ALL VERIFIED SNIPPET (the briefing confirmed exactly). The RAI-refractory-definition/when-to-start companion matched (28665259) | PMID 25671254 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

DECISION (Brose, Lancet 2014 - PMID 24768112, pubmed-url-match): sorafenib in RAI-refractory DTC - PMID VERIFIED, the PFS numbers (10.8 vs 5.8, HR 0.59) MEMORY-GRADE and NOT quoted: carried qualitatively as 'significant PFS benefit' until re-verified | PMID 24768112 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

Cabozantinib post-lenvatinib/sorafenib RAI-refractory DTC (COSMIC-311, FDA 2021) - SECONDHAND-STALE this sweep (memory + indirect references only; NOT re-verified): the label must be verified before any item quotes it - flagged as exactly that

LIBRETTO-001 thyroid (Wirth, NEJM 2020 - PMID 32846061, pubmed-url-match): selpercatinib ORR 73% (95% CI 62-82) in 88 RET-mutant MTC without prior vandetanib/cabozantinib (verified snippet; the 69%-prior-treated and 79%-fusion-DTC splits memory-grade - THE MUDDLED-SNIPPET TRAP documented); long-term update matched (39094065: ORR >84% naive MTC, 95% fusion-positive DTC per snippet); first-line exploratory analysis matched (38201566) | PMID 32846061 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

ARROW pralsetinib (primary 34118198 + update 38009200, both pubmed-url-matched: ORR 55.7% prior-treated RET-mutant MTC / 77.4% naive / 90.9% RET-fusion TC per update snippet) - AND THE SPLIT (the stack's 12th premise correction, verified via the Genentech 2023-06-29 statement + OncLive/ThyCa): the US RET-MUTANT-MTC indication was VOLUNTARILY WITHDRAWN effective 2023-07-10 (confirmatory phase 3 not completable - explicitly NOT safety); the RET-FUSION thyroid indication SURVIVES under ACCELERATED approval (NDA transferred to Rigel 2024-06). The briefing's plural 'thyroid indications' was OVERBROAD. Property-enforced: pralsetinib on NO card; the split IS the teaching | PMID 34118198 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

LIBRETTO-531 (Hadoux, NEJM 2023 - PMID 37870969, pubmed-url-match): selpercatinib SUPERIOR to cabozantinib/vandetanib first-line in advanced RET-mutant MTC (PFS + treatment-failure-free survival; the HR memory-grade and NOT quoted); design paper matched (35969032); FULL (traditional) FDA approval on this trial VERIFIED (adults + peds >=2) - the first-line rewrite | PMID 37870969 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

NTRK tumor-agnostic (Drilon, NEJM 2018 - PMID 29466156, pubmed-url-match): larotrectinib ORR 75% independent review across 17 tumor types, 71% of responses ongoing at 1 year (verified snippet; the thyroid-subset ORR memory-grade - not quoted). Entrectinib: UNVERIFIED this sweep - absent from cards, not denied | PMID 29466156 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

BRAF V600E ATC: Subbiah (JCO 2018 - PMID 29072975, pubmed-url-match - the approval-basis paper) + ROAR updated analysis (35026411, matched: 36 ATC patients, ORR 56%; 12-mo OS 51.7%, 24-mo 31.5% - verified snippet) + ROAR pan-tumor (37059834, matched). THE ANALYSIS-GENERATIONS TRAP documented: the 23-patient interim's ~69% is memory-grade and never quoted as current. FDA May 2018 date memory-grade | PMID 29072975 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE NEOADJUVANT CONVERSION (the modern ATC move): Wang (Thyroid 2019 - PMID 31319771, pubmed-url-match): 6 of 6 consecutive BRAF-mutant ATC patients achieved COMPLETE RESECTION after neoadjuvant dabrafenib+trametinib (3 with pembrolizumab) - verified snippet; Cabanillas companion matched (29742974). The multicenter DTP trial (NCT04675710, MD Anderson 2020-0641): median OS 20 months / 2-yr 48% at ASCO 2025 (secondhand) - WITH ITS CONFLICT SAID LOUDLY: results presented yet institutional pages still list it open; accrual status UNVERIFIED | PMID 31319771 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

The demoted-but-honest MTC receipts, verified: ZETA vandetanib (JCO 2012 - PMID 22025146, pubmed-url-match: PFS HR 0.46 [95% CI 0.31-0.69]; AE profile verified snippet; median PFS values memory-grade) + EXAM cabozantinib (JCO 2013 - PMID 24002501, matched: 330 pts, PFS 11.2 vs 4.0 months, ORR 28% vs 0%, benefit regardless of RET status - verified snippet; OS analysis 29045520 matched; FDA 2012-11-29 secondary-source grade); ZETA progressive/symptomatic post hoc matched (32584630 - supports watching indolent disease) | PMID 22025146 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE CALCITONIN/CEA CLOCK + MEN2/germline logic - CONSENSUS-GRADE THIS SWEEP: doubling-time thresholds, the ATA MTC guideline (Wells), and the RET codon-risk tables were NOT verified (searches exhausted) - the concepts are carried as the guideline conventions they are, NO threshold numbers ship, and the receipts are queued as the next sweep's first chase. None fabricated

THE RET PULLBACK, said plainly: TPX-0046 TERMINATED May 2023 (risk-benefit; NCT04161391); vepafestinib (TAS0953) ABSENT from Taiho/Helsinn pipelines since ~2024-02 (presumed discontinued); pralsetinib's MTC indication withdrawn (see arrow ref) - EP0031/A400 (lunbotinib) is the surviving next-gen program (FDA Fast Track in NSCLC; pivotal NSCLC data ASCO 2026) with its thyroid/MTC accrual status UNCONFIRMED. The resistance frontier's honest description is a retreat with one survivor

THE SHELF + EMPTY BUCKETS, said: active surveillance = INSTITUTIONAL pathway (MSK), no US NCT verified (the Korean registered AS trials NCT02938702/NCT06261190 are EX-US - never listed as US doors); US redifferentiation EFFECTIVELY EMPTY (ERRITI Germany, MERAIODE-type France, SEL-I-METRY UK - all read out, all ex-US; NCT06440850 vemurafenib+cobimetinib high-risk DTC = UNVERIFIED LEAD ONLY); cooperative-group thyroid trials UNVERIFIED-EMPTY (one-pass search); Lutathera-in-MTC = UK only (NCT06121271); lenvatinib+pembro RAIR-DTC read out (CCR 2024); ATLEP German; UVA neoadjuvant-zanzalintinib NCT unverified; EB-TATE oncocytic door status unverified

El-Jawahri A, LeBlanc T, VanDusen H, et al. Effect of Inpatient Palliative Care on Quality of Life 2 Weeks After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.

Zanzalintinib (XL092) phase 2, RAI-refractory DTC (NCT06959641, Northwestern/NCI): single-arm, alive-and-progression-free-at-12-months primary; est. primary completion 2028-09 - RECRUITING per UC Health + NCI listings - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08-20, registry re-check due; LINE-OF-THERAPY ELIGIBILITY UNCONFIRMED (flagged). The clearest novel US door in RAIR-DTC

FORTE plixorafenib (FORE8394) master protocol (NCT05503797): phase 2 basket, BRAF V600 monomer + BRAF-fusion 'paradox breaker', ages >=10, thyroid a NAMED cohort (efficacy data ATA 2025) - RECRUITING (54 sites/9 countries per Jan 2025 snippet) - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08-20, registry re-check due; US-site list INFERRED not itemized (flagged)

EP0031/A400 (lunbotinib) next-gen selective RET inhibitor (NCT05443126, Ellipses): phase 1/2 - ph1 all RET-altered tumors incl. thyroid/MTC, ph2 expansions NSCLC-focused (pivotal NSCLC data ASCO 2026; FDA Fast Track NSCLC) - ongoing US/EU/UK/UAE - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08-20; WHETHER A THYROID/MTC COHORT IS OPEN TO ACCRUAL IS UNCONFIRMED - LOUD FLAG, registry re-check REQUIRED before any referral.
